datasets.name: 867c7450
queryLines:
SELECT area, region, lon, lat, level_today_name AS today, predicted_level AS forecast, direction,
       round(p_high, 2) AS p_high, CAST(new_cluster_rank AS INT) AS new_cluster_rank,
       round(new_cluster_score, 2) AS new_cluster_score, new_cluster_watch, why,
       predicted_level_num, level_today, recent_cases, n_clusters,
       basis_date, CAST(locked_at_utc AS DATE) AS locked_on, score_from, score_until
FROM workspace.dengue.gold_forecast_latest
ORDER BY predicted_level_num DESC, p_high DESC, new_cluster_rank

datasets.name: 5e723fc5
queryLines:
SELECT
  count_if(predicted_level = 'High') AS high_areas,
  count_if(predicted_level = 'Medium') AS medium_areas,
  count_if(level_today > 0) AS areas_with_clusters_today,
  max(basis_date) AS basis_date,
  (SELECT plan_homes FROM workspace.dengue.gold_team_plan_summary) AS plan_homes,
  (SELECT round(homes_ratio, 1) FROM workspace.dengue.gold_team_plan_summary) AS plan_ratio
FROM workspace.dengue.gold_forecast_latest

datasets.name: 4dba9e00
queryLines:
SELECT max(basis_date) AS basis_date, CAST(max(locked_at_utc) AS DATE) AS locked_on, max(score_from) AS score_from
FROM workspace.dengue.gold_forecast_latest

datasets.name: f4337874
queryLines:
SELECT CAST(new_cluster_rank AS INT) AS rank, area, round(new_cluster_score, 2) AS score, why
FROM workspace.dengue.gold_forecast_latest
WHERE new_cluster_watch
ORDER BY new_cluster_rank

datasets.name: c35323c2
queryLines:
SELECT team, anchor, area, blocks, homes, blocks_near_cluster, homes_in_wolbachia, cluster_list_date
FROM workspace.dengue.gold_team_plan ORDER BY team

datasets.name: c19b9e44
queryLines:
SELECT 'Team planner' AS plan, plan_homes AS priority_homes FROM workspace.dengue.gold_team_plan_summary
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Top blocks, spread out', simple_homes FROM workspace.dengue.gold_team_plan_summary

datasets.name: fc4076c0
queryLines:
SELECT basis_date, CAST(min(locked_at_utc) AS DATE) AS locked_on, min(score_from) AS score_from,
       min(score_until) AS score_until, max(status) AS status, max(outcome_date) AS outcome_list,
       count(*) AS areas,
       count_if(model_right) AS model_right, count_if(same_as_now_right) AS same_as_now_right,
       count_if(predicted_level = 'High' AND outcome_level = 'High') AS high_caught,
       count_if(outcome_level = 'High') AS high_outcomes,
       count_if(new_cluster_rank <= 5 AND new_cluster_appeared) AS new_clusters_in_top5,
       count_if(new_cluster_appeared) AS new_clusters,
       left(max(git_commit), 7) AS code
FROM workspace.dengue.gold_track_record
GROUP BY basis_date ORDER BY basis_date DESC

datasets.name: 4ce7a814
queryLines:
SELECT question, baseline_name AS compared_with, round(100 * model, 1) AS model_pct,
       round(100 * baseline, 1) AS baseline_pct,
       CASE WHEN diff_p05 IS NULL THEN '' ELSE concat(format_number(100 * diff_p05, 1), ' to +', format_number(100 * diff_p95, 1), ' pts') END AS difference_90pct,
       test, test_lists
FROM workspace.dengue.gold_model_test_headline

datasets.name: 93103db1
queryLines:
SELECT CAST(year AS STRING) AS year, lists, high_outcomes, round(high_f1, 2) AS model_high_f1,
       round(same_as_now_high_f1, 2) AS same_as_now_high_f1, new_clusters,
       round(100 * caught_at_5, 0) AS model_caught_pct, round(100 * past_clusters_caught_at_5, 0) AS past_clusters_caught_pct
FROM workspace.dengue.gold_model_test_by_year ORDER BY year

datasets.name: 68073b68
queryLines: SELECT week_end, cases FROM workspace.dengue.gold_national_weekly WHERE week_end >= '2019-01-01' ORDER BY week_end

lines: Two-week dengue risk for Singapore's 55 planning areas, from the newest **locked** forecast (it can't be edited once written). Levels use NEA's alert rule: **High** = a cluster with 10+ cases, **Medium** = any active cluster, **Low** = none.

frame.title: Priority homes, 6 teams
frame.description: covered by this week's team plan

frame.title: × the simple plan
frame.description: homes reached vs top blocks spread out

frame.title: Risk map (one dot per planning area)
frame.description: Hover a dot for the area and P(High)

frame.title: New-cluster watch
frame.description: Areas clear today, ranked by the chance a new cluster starts within two weeks

frame.title: Risk by area
frame.description: Every planning area, highest risk first. Reasons describe the model's inputs for the area, not its weights.

lines: One inspection site per team, no overlaps: an anchor HDB block plus every priority block within 300 m. Priority = near a cluster on the newest NEA list (×3), near a high-mosquito area (×2), or in an area the forecast flags (×1); halved inside Wolbachia zones.

Every forecast is locked in an append-only table before the outcome is known, then scored against NEA's first list 14–35 days later. The test below predicts every year from 2020 using only the years before it.

frame.title: Locked forecasts
frame.description: status = waiting until NEA publishes a list in the scoring window

frame.title: Test 2020–26: model vs simple rules
frame.description: High-risk row is F1 ×100 (balance of catching High areas and avoiding false alarms). Range = model minus rule, resampling list dates.

frame.title: Test by year
frame.description: 2021 and 2023 have no NEA list with a known outcome two weeks later

frame.title: Weekly dengue cases, Singapore
frame.description: MOH and CDA weekly bulletins, no missing weeks
